summary: OS Therapies Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 500,000 shares of common stock to Leonite Fund I, LP as consideration under a settlement agreement dated July 31, 2026. No cash proceeds, placement agent, or underwriting discounts; shares issued directly to settle disputes involving the company and its subsidiaries. Closing price on August 5, 2026, was $1.60 per share. This is a routine securities issuance for settlement, not a special situation.
